35” Falken Wild Peak AT tires

———————————————————
I’ve owned this truck for 4 years now and it’s time to say goodbye. I have all documents of any work done on the truck. Less than 5000 miles on new 35” Falken Wild Peak AT tires. Replaced the belt and starter last year, and recently got a new seal on a coolant line leaking, as well as brand new KSP upper control arms (have documentation for that as well). Has 5% tint on sides and rear and 15% on the shield. Also has airbags in the rear with Bilstien rear shocks. It’s an older truck so there’s small dings here and there on the truck, and the only thing broken inside is the rear cup holders. Also has starlights in the roof as well as 2 8” subs in the rear that I’ll throw in for cash on top! It’s a great truck just looking to upgrade.

Denver broncos football helmet (throwback)

Denver broncos throw back Riddell speed football helmet size large. This is not a replica helmet this is an authentic Riddell speed that has been reconditioned and painted in Denver blue and sealed with a automotive 2k clear coat from a spray gun and then buffed and polished to a glossy shine. The decals are a thick 20 mills like most nfl teams use. This is a very nice looking helmet.

Selling my 2008 BMW R1200RT with approximately 85,000 miles. This is a very clean, well-maintained RT that has been ridden and cared for.

Nicely equipped with:
• Electronic Suspension Adjustment (ESA)
• Heated seat
• Heated grips
• Cruise control
• Tire Pressure Monitoring (TPM)
• ABS
• Electrically adjustable windshield
• Genuine BMW top case
• Shaft drive
• 1,170cc BMW Boxer twin
• 6-speed transmission
• Relatively newer tires

The bike has received regular maintenance and oil changes and presents extremely well for its age and mileage.

These R1200RTs were built for long-distance riding. It’s extremely comfortable on a road trip, has excellent wind protection and luggage capacity, but is still a lot of fun on Colorado mountain roads.

No side cases and no radio.

I’m selling because I’m simply not riding enough anymore and would rather see it go to someone who will enjoy it.

Clean title. Located in Grand Junction, Colorado.
